package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/internal/oneline"
)

// writesWorker wraps the path in oneline.Quote, this repo's wrapper over
// strconv.Quote. The network it reports on is a fake.
func writesWorker(dir string) {
	body := `{"name":"w","key_file":` + oneline.Quote(filepath.Join(dir, "key")) + `}`
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "worker.json"), []byte(body), 0o644)
}
